title: Check To Make Sure the Lids Close on All 4 Sides!!!
text: Check To Make Sure the Lids Close on All 4 Sides!!!. This item came with 3 containers. The lid on the middle container wouldn't close. I got two sides to close, but the other two sides wouldn't close, no matter how hard I tried. So, what good is that? I love these containers otherwise.

product_metadata.title: 14 Cup/ 112 oz LARGE Glass Food Storage Container with Locking Lid. Ideal for Storing food, Vegetables or Fruits. Baking Casserole, Lasagna, Baking, Roasting chicken & lot of other tasty Food BPA Free
features: Largest Glass Container With Airtight Locking Lid.

Quality Design - 112 oz / 3300 ml/ 14 cups, Glass Container with locking lid, is the largest you will find with locking lid). Razab uses premium grade material to bring you industrial and restaurant grade glass to your home kitchen.

Airtight Leak Proof - Multipurpose can be used as bakeware or for storage. The perfect solution to bake your lasagna for lunch or meat / chicken for dinner and store them as well. Silicone sealed bpa-free plastic lids (plastic lid is not microwave or oven safe).

Leak Proof Storage - Container is easily sealed, air tight and spill proof. Square glass food container - keep leftovers fresh, goes straight from the refrigerator to the microwave or oven to the table. food can be cooked directly in the container using microwave or oven. Less dead space while stored in refrigerator due to its square shape.

Borosilicate Glass for Versatile Use - Reusable refrigerator, freezer, microwave and dishwasher-safe (top shelf of dishwasher recommended), heat resistant up to 980°F, and thermal shock resistant up to 248°F. NOTE: Plastic lid not microwave or oven safe.
